surfaces.name: console
surfaces.description: Operator app inside the GoHighLevel iframe. Dense, desktop-first, worked dozens of times a day.

surfaces.name: investor-document
surfaces.description: Public pages served at /d/<token>: the deal package and the all-deals portfolio. Read once, on a phone, by someone outside the business deciding whether to spend money.
surfaces.notes: Shares the console palette and typeface exactly; introduces no colors or radii of its own.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: A flat, Swiss-minimal operator console: white working surfaces on cool paper, hairline borders instead of shadows, one decisive blue for actions and one green reserved for money moving the operator's way. Dense by design — the user works it dozens of times a day inside a GoHighLevel iframe, so scanability and speed outrank expression.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, hairline borders, shadows on overlays only
Dense 14px/12px text scale with uppercase tracked labels
Blue = act, green = money in, amber = attention, red = risk

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue acts, green counts money. No other saturated color except amber/red status semantics.

rules.name: The Gray-Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text de-emphasis walks slate 900→700→500→400 and never drops below slate-500 for text a user must read.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 12px; legacy 11px chips are the floor exception and stay bold + high-contrast.

rules.name: Two Surfaces, One Palette
rules.body: The console and the investor document share colors, typeface and flat/hairline construction, but not the type scale. The console optimizes for density; the investor document optimizes for legibility and confidence on a phone. Reaching for the console's 14px body on an investor page means that page is trying to be a table when it should be a document.

dos: Do right-align and embolden every money figure; Deal Green only when money flows to the operator.
Do keep table-heavy views full-bleed and forms capped; header gutters match content gutters.
Do use hairline borders for structure and background steps for depth.
Do keep transitions 150–250ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add shadows to in-page cards, gradients anywhere, or a third accent hue.
Don't use text lighter than slate-500 for content, or functional text under 12px.
Don't use emojis as icons — Lucide SVGs only.
Don't use scale/translate hovers that shift layout.
